name: Story tool for presentations
summary: Story Builder is a Celbridge package that adds an editor for .story files, used to build slide decks and choose-your-own-adventure stories from Markdown passages. Each passage is a Marp slide that can hold headings, code, maths, images, and diagrams written as text with Mermaid or nomnoml. Passages can be laid out as a graph or a list, previewed as you type, and presented full screen with keyboard controls. Decks export to PDF with selectable, searchable text and clickable choice links.
